reason: I do not know a single company that uses it, and they say only 1 to 5 firms pay today. I would not move my clients out of Excel and Telegram into something with no references, and $29 a month is real money on my income when a free tier or my current setup works.
objection: Who else uses it? I cannot find any company I know. If it disappears in a year, I lose my client list and my time.
would_change_my_mind: A free tier or a free first month that lets me try it with my own clients, plus a shop or service business I know in Tashkent who tells me it works.
